title: Welcome party for Hawk and the Hawkins-Basie battle
summary: At a party after Hawkins returned from Europe, Ben wanted to fight Lester, but at the battle of the bands Hawk settled it with six choruses.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: They could have. We had a nightclub called the Band Box for all the bands, musicians come in there, white and colored. So when Hawk came in town, he looked for me. I was playing (unintelligible), said, Ben said (unintelligible) to me, he said, hey, Hap, said, Hawk's in town (unintelligible). I said, yeah, we want to have a little party down at the club because (I was a member-part owner of the club. And (unintelligible) --
Oh, wait a minute. I better just put this on.
I'd go down and listen to him.
Well, yeah, Hawk comes back from Europe, right?
Right. And that's when after (unintelligible) he made that "Body and Soul" because he had the big band.

So we said, I said, Ben, we're going to have a little party for Hawk on his return back to the States. Dan Byas and all (unintelligible) be there and Ben come, and, well, I said, Lester going to be there. You know, I ought to punch that so and so in his mouth. I said, Ben, don't come down and break up the joint, said don't pay it no mind. So Lester came in here, and Lester's (unintelligible) that's going to play, down, lot of the fellows, different bands downtown, why, they'd come and they'd play. They cut Basie's half - (unintelligible)

So he had to get between Ben -- I said, Ben, let him alone. Don't bother him. Go on and play. He said, I'm going to take his horn and shove it down his damn throat. I said, oh, boy. I said (unintelligible), come on and have a little taste. So they had a battle of jazz. Basie's band and Hawk's band -- see, Hawk had this big band. After that's how he made this "Body and Soul" at the Golden Gate Ballroom, which is about two blocks --
What was the other band? Hawk's
Hawk had his big band then after he came back from Europe because that's when he made --

Basie, see -- Lester was with Basie. Now, everybody -- musicians going to go and see this thing, you know. So Ben said, Hap, hey, where you going? I said, let's go up there and hear the battle between Basie and Hawk. Yeah. All right. I'll pick you up. He had a car, you know. Pick you up -- I said okay. Well, man, (unintelligible) trump that bastard (unintelligible).

I said, well, I said, guy's all right. But, Hap, so and so and so and so. I said, I go along with him, though. Pacify him. So they played together up there, band played. Hawk played -- a fast tune. Oh, man, he did about six choruses. That was the end of it. House (unintelligible) came in. Ben said, I told you, Hap. I said, that was the man trying to fill the big man's shoe. That satisfied Ben, because Hawk would have ate it up that night, because he knew a little -- you know, that's the end. And Hawk didn't hate Lester, but Hawk was going to prove, and that's what he did. And that did that's all Ben wanted he'd -- Hawk didn't want it. I told you I'd kill that bum.
